name: Kusari gusoku
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 9, Ultimate Combat pg. 128
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 9, Ultimate Combat pg. 128
Statistics
Cost 350 gp Weight 45 lbs.
Armor Bonus +7; Max Dex Bonus +1; Armor Check Penalty -7
Arcane Spell Failure Chance 35%; Speed 20 ft./15 ft.
Description
Kusari gusoku is similar to tatami-do armor; however, a katabira— a type of chain jacket—is worn in place of the chest armor.
